---
title: "Figures from the simulation"
---

This file draws Figures 1 to 6 and Supplementary Figs. 1 to 5 from the results of `Code/1_simulation.qmd` and `Code/2_calculations.qmd`, and saves them in `Figures/`.

```{r}
#| include: false
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
source(knitr::purl(here::here("Code/0_functions.qmd"), output = tempfile(fileext = ".R"), quiet = TRUE))
dir.create(here::here("Figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
fig <- \(name) here::here("Figures", name)

populations <- readRDS(here::here("Results/populations.rds"))

sum_res <-
  rbind(
    readRDS(here::here("Results/proxy_results_summary.rds")),
    readRDS(here::here("Results/water_results_summary.rds"))
  ) %>%
  .[, prod_het := factor(str_to_title(prod_het), c("Zero", "Medium", "High"))]

#--- color-blind-safe colors (Okabe-Ito) and panel labels ---#
pal_measure <- c(Proxy = "#D55E00", Water = "#0072B2")
pal_instrument <- c(Quota = "#E69F00", Trading = "#009E73")
panel_labels <- labeller(
  u_dev = \(x) paste("Error level:", x),
  prod_het = \(x) paste("Heterogeneity:", x)
)

#--- water-based results repeated for each error level, to share panels with the proxy-based results ---#
water_by_error <- \(d) expand_grid_df(d[, setdiff(names(d), "u_dev"), with = FALSE], data.table(u_dev = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5)))
```

## Farmers' profit-maximizing water use (Supplementary Fig. 1)

```{r}
g_opt_w_dist <-
  populations %>%
  dplyr::select(prod_het, farmer_data) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(farmer_data)) %>%
  data.table() %>%
  .[, type_txt := factor(
    paste("Heterogeneity:", str_to_title(prod_het)),
    levels = c("Heterogeneity: Zero", "Heterogeneity: Medium", "Heterogeneity: High")
  )] %>%
  .[opt_w_true < 30, ] %>%
  ggplot(data = .) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = opt_w_true, y = ifelse(after_stat(count) > 0, after_stat(count), NA)), color = "blue", fill = NA) +
  facet_grid(type_txt ~ .) +
  xlab("Optimal Water Use (inches)") +
  ylab("Count") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 2)) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(fig("g_opt_w_dist.png"), g_opt_w_dist, height = 5, width = 6, dpi = 400)
```

## Ratio of estimated to actual water use (Supplementary Fig. 2)

One draw for the 1,000 farmers at each error level.

```{r}
set.seed(20241113)

eta_data <-
  lapply(c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5), \(u) {
    make_quota_data(populations$farmer_data[[1]], target_w = 7, u_dev = u, num_it = 1) %>%
      .[, u_dev := u]
  }) %>%
  rbindlist() %>%
  .[, med_txt := paste0("Error level: ", u_dev)]

g_eta_dist <-
  ggplot(eta_data) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = water_to_proxy, y = ifelse(after_stat(count) > 0, after_stat(count), NA)), color = "blue", fill = NA) +
  facet_grid(med_txt ~ .) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Estimated / actual water use (eta)") +
  ylab("Count")

ggsave(fig("g_eta_dist.png"), g_eta_dist, height = 5, width = 6, dpi = 400)
```

## Profit under a water quota and a proxy quota (Figure 2)

```{r}
quota_plot_data <-
  rbind(sum_res[measure_type == "Proxy", ], water_by_error(sum_res[measure_type == "Water", ])) %>%
  .[instrument_type == "Quota", ]

y_lims <- quota_plot_data[, c(floor(min(profit / 10)), ceiling(max(profit / 10)))] * 10

g_profit_quota_comp_stat <-
  ggplot(data = quota_plot_data) +
  geom_line(aes(y = profit, x = w, color = measure_type)) +
  facet_grid(u_dev ~ prod_het, labeller = panel_labels) +
  ylab("Profit ($/acre)") +
  xlab("Realized Water Use (inches)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_measure, name = "Measurement Type") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(y_lims[1], y_lims[2], by = 10)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 7:12) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"))

ggsave(fig("g_profit_quota_comp_stat.png"), g_profit_quota_comp_stat, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 400)
```

## Profit under quotas and trading (Figure 5)

```{r}
trading_plot_data <-
  rbind(water_by_error(sum_res[measure_type == "Water", ]), sum_res[u_dev != 0 & measure_type == "Proxy", ])

y_lims <- trading_plot_data[, c(floor(min(profit / 10)), ceiling(max(profit / 10)))] * 10

g_trade_effect_profit <-
  ggplot(data = trading_plot_data) +
  geom_line(aes(y = profit, x = w, color = measure_type, linetype = instrument_type)) +
  facet_grid(u_dev ~ prod_het, labeller = panel_labels) +
  ylab("Profit ($/acre)") +
  xlab("Realized Water Use (inches)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_measure, name = "Measurement") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Quota = "solid", Trading = "dashed"), name = "Policy") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(y_lims[1], y_lims[2], by = 10)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 7:12) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"))

ggsave(fig("g_trade_effect_profit.png"), g_trade_effect_profit, height = 6, width = 6, dpi = 400)
```

## Each farmer's change in profit (Figure 6)

```{r}
profit_change <- readRDS(here::here("Results/profit_change.rds"))

g_profit_change <-
  ggplot(profit_change) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_line(aes(x = change, y = prob, color = instrument_type)) +
  facet_grid(u_dev ~ prod_het, labeller = panel_labels) +
  xlab("Change in profit from the water-based to the proxy-based policy ($/acre)") +
  ylab("Cumulative Probability") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_instrument, name = "Instrument Type") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.6, "lines")
  )

ggsave(fig("g_profit_change.png"), g_profit_change, height = 6, width = 6, dpi = 400)
```

## Realized water use against the nominal cap (Supplementary Fig. 3)

```{r}
quota_target_data <-
  rbind(water_by_error(sum_res[measure_type == "Water", ]), sum_res[measure_type == "Proxy", ]) %>%
  #--- nominal cap: the quota itself, or under trading the allowance per farmer (average estimated use) ---#
  .[, nominal := ifelse(instrument_type == "Quota", target_w, proxy)]

g_quota_target <-
  ggplot(data = quota_target_data) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_line(aes(x = nominal, y = w, color = measure_type, linetype = instrument_type)) +
  facet_grid(u_dev ~ prod_het, labeller = panel_labels) +
  xlab("Nominal cap per farmer (inches of water or of estimated water use)") +
  ylab("Realized water use (inches)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_measure, name = "Measurement") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Quota = "solid", Trading = "dashed"), name = "Policy") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 7:13) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"))

ggsave(fig("g_quota_target.png"), g_quota_target, height = 6, width = 6, dpi = 400)
```

## Errors related to water demand (Supplementary Fig. 4)

Computed exactly in `Code/2_calculations.qmd` for the medium- and high-heterogeneity populations. With identical farmers the three cases are the same.

```{r}
relation_levels <- c("Water quota", "Unrelated to demand", "High-demand farmers under-estimated", "High-demand farmers over-estimated")
relation_labels <- c("Water quota", paste("Proxy quota, errors", c("unrelated to water demand", "with high-demand farmers under-estimated", "with high-demand farmers over-estimated")))

demand_relation_data <-
  readRDS(here::here("Results/demand_relation.rds"))$curves %>%
  .[, policy := factor(relation_labels[match(policy, relation_levels)], levels = relation_labels)] %>%
  .[, prod_het := factor(prod_het, c("Medium", "High"))]

g_profit_dir_cor <-
  ggplot(data = demand_relation_data) +
  geom_line(aes(y = profit, x = w, color = policy, linetype = policy)) +
  facet_grid(prod_het ~ u_dev, labeller = panel_labels, scales = "free_y") +
  ylab("Profit ($/acre)") +
  xlab("Realized Water Use (inches)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(c(pal_measure[["Water"]], rep(pal_measure[["Proxy"]], 3)), relation_labels), name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c("solid", "solid", "dashed", "dotted"), relation_labels), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 7:11) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1), linetype = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"))

ggsave(fig("g_profit_dir_cor.png"), g_profit_dir_cor, height = 6, width = 6.5, dpi = 400)
```

## Two senses of an unbiased estimate (Supplementary Fig. 5)

```{r}
def_labels <- c(
  w_def1 = "Proxy quota, estimated / actual use averages 1",
  w_def2 = "Proxy quota, actual / estimated use averages 1",
  trade_def1 = "Proxy-quota trading, estimated / actual use averages 1",
  trade_def2 = "Proxy-quota trading, actual / estimated use averages 1"
)

quota_target_def_data <-
  rbind(
    readRDS(here::here("Results/quota_target_def.rds")) %>%
      melt(id.vars = c("prod_het", "u_dev", "target_w"), variable.name = "policy", value.name = "w") %>%
      .[, policy := def_labels[as.character(policy)]],
    water_by_error(sum_res[measure_type == "Water" & instrument_type == "Quota", .(prod_het, target_w, w)])[, policy := "Water quota"]
  ) %>%
  .[, policy := factor(policy, levels = c("Water quota", def_labels))]

g_quota_target_def <-
  ggplot(data = quota_target_def_data) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_line(aes(x = target_w, y = w, color = policy, linetype = policy)) +
  facet_grid(u_dev ~ prod_het, labeller = panel_labels) +
  xlab("Nominal cap per farmer (inches of water or of estimated water use)") +
  ylab("Realized water use (inches)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(c(pal_measure[["Water"]], rep(pal_measure[["Proxy"]], 2), rep(pal_instrument[["Trading"]], 2)), levels(quota_target_def_data$policy)), name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c("solid", "solid", "dashed", "solid", "dashed"), levels(quota_target_def_data$policy)), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 7:13) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1), linetype = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines")
  )

ggsave(fig("g_quota_target_def.png"), g_quota_target_def, height = 7, width = 6, dpi = 400)
```

## Two-farmer examples (Figures 1, 3 and 4)

```{r}
il <- readRDS(here::here("Results/illustration_data.rds"))

#--- the vertical axis shows the profit curves from 50 below the lowest marked point; a grey line marks zero profit ---#
marked <- c(il$production_at_quota$profit, il$proxy_trade_data$profit, il$quota_data_het$profit)
y_range <- c(floor(min(marked) / 50) * 50 - 50, ceiling(max(il$farm_data_1$profit, il$farm_data_het$profit) / 50) * 50)

profit_axis <- list(
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60"),
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:15),
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-1000, 1000, by = 50)),
  coord_cartesian(ylim = y_range),
  theme_bw(),
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
)

#--- Figure 1: identical farmers under a water quota and a proxy quota ---#
g_illustration_homogeneous <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = il$farm_data_1, aes(y = profit, x = w)) +
  geom_vline(data = il$production_at_quota, aes(xintercept = quota), linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  geom_point(data = il$production_at_quota, aes(y = profit, x = w), color = "blue", size = 2) +
  facet_grid(measure_type ~ farmer) +
  xlab("Water Use (inches)") +
  ylab("Profit ($/acre)") +
  profit_axis

ggsave(fig("g_illustration_homogeneous.png"), g_illustration_homogeneous, height = 4.5, width = 6.5, dpi = 400)

#--- Figure 4: the same farmers when the proxy quota can be traded ---#
g_illustration_homogeneous_with_trade <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = il$farm_data_1, aes(y = profit, x = w)) +
  geom_vline(data = il$production_at_quota, aes(xintercept = quota), linetype = 2, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(data = il$proxy_trade_data, aes(xintercept = w), linetype = 2, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = il$production_at_quota, aes(y = profit, x = w, color = instrument_type), size = 3) +
  geom_point(data = il$proxy_trade_data, aes(x = w, y = profit, color = instrument_type), size = 3) +
  geom_segment(
    data = data.table(
      x = il$production_at_quota[measure_type == "Proxy", w],
      y = rep(y_range[1] + 25, 2),
      xend = il$proxy_trade_data[measure_type == "Proxy", w],
      yend = rep(y_range[1] + 25, 2),
      measure_type = c("Proxy", "Proxy"),
      farmer = c("A", "B")
    ),
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"))
  ) +
  facet_grid(measure_type ~ farmer) +
  xlab("Water Use (inches)") +
  ylab("Profit ($/acre)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_instrument, name = "Instrument Type") +
  profit_axis

ggsave(fig("g_illustration_homogeneous_with_trade.png"), g_illustration_homogeneous_with_trade, height = 5, width = 6.5, dpi = 400)

#--- Figure 3: farmers with different water demand ---#
g_illustration_het <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = il$farm_data_het, aes(y = profit, x = w)) +
  geom_vline(data = il$quota_data_het, aes(xintercept = quota), linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  geom_point(data = il$quota_data_het, aes(y = profit, x = w), color = "blue", size = 2) +
  facet_grid(measure_type ~ farmer_txt) +
  xlab("Water Use (inches)") +
  ylab("Profit ($/acre)") +
  profit_axis

ggsave(fig("g_illustration_het.png"), g_illustration_het, height = 4.5, width = 6.5, dpi = 400)
```
